issues.explanation: Login::render and Register::render return the bare component view with no layout wiring (no #[Layout] or ->layout()), so the full-page Livewire routes render without the new layouts/app.blade.php shell used by all plain Blade auth views.

RateLimiter::hit is only called after User::create, so failed validations never increment the register|IP counter and an attacker can spam invalid registration attempts without ever hitting the 5-attempt throttle.
Password confirmation is validated via a protected rules() method while name/email use #[Validate], deviating from the project pattern of #[Validate] plus $this->validate() for Livewire components.
Client-writable public bool $remember has no validation rule, so a tampered non-boolean payload is not rejected server-side.
mount() calls $this->redirectRoute without returning, which does not halt rendering; the guest middleware already handles the redirect, making this dead/redundant code.
Import-only churn in bootstrap/providers.php with no behavioral change.

conventions.evidence: Mostly follows: #[Validate] on email/name, inline $request->validate in controllers, route() in all views, plain wire:model, CHANGELOG/README updated. Deviations: password via rules() not #[Validate] (Register.php:388-393); Livewire full-page components have no layout wiring despite layouts/app.blade.php existing.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (Login::submit, Register::submit, VerifyEmailController::__invoke), clear names, sibling style, {{ }} escaping; only nit is non-returning redirect in mount.

requirements.evidence: Login/Register/logout/home/forgot/reset/verify/localization/routes all present with strict email, Password::defaults, MustVerifyEmail, remember_token rotation, 403 on tampered id, single name=email input. Gap: Livewire full-page components return bare views with no Blade layout (Login.php:341-344, Register.php:426-429).

scope.evidence: Diff is auth-only plus required locale/test wiring; only trivial import/whitespace churn in bootstrap/providers.php and lang newlines.

security.evidence: Server-side validation everywhere, auth.failed/auth.throttle on email, signed+throttled verify with hash_equals 403 checks, strict email, {{ }} escaping, Fillable safe. Gaps: Register::hit only on success (Register.php:417) so failed attempts bypass throttle; public $remember has no boolean rule.

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct implementation reusing Auth/Password/RateLimiter/Password::defaults; no service layers, no speculative abstractions, no duplication.

tests.evidence: New Pest suites cover login/register/reset/verify/localization including rate-limit, throttle 429, tampered-link 403, weak-password and confirmed/unique cases; missing an authenticated/unauthorized call test for Livewire submit actions required by the Livewire policy.

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR session auth flow with throttling, signed verification, password defaults, localization and broad Pest coverage. Needs changes before merging because Livewire login/register pages are not wired to the new Blade layout and registration throttling only counts successful creates.
